'''Clue scroll (easy)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 848
|text = The cryptic reveals where to dig:<br><br>Dig under Ithoi's cabin.
|notes = Dig near [[Ithoi the Navigator|Ithoi]]'s cabin in [[Corsair Cove]].
|map = {{Map|2529,2838|mtype=pin|plane=0|mapID=-1}}
}}

==Transportation==
*[[Spirit tree]] to [[Feldip Hills]] and run east.
*[[Charter ship]] to [[Corsair Cove]] and run west.
*[[Mythical cape]] teleport to the [[Myths' Guild]].
*Board a boat to [[Corsair Cove]] via [[Captain Tock]] or [[Cabin Boy Colin]] west of [[Rimmington]], with partial completion of [[The Corsair Curse]].
*[[Feldip hills teleport]] and enter [[Corsair Cove]] with the northern [[Agility shortcut]], requiring 10 [[Agility]].
*[[Fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|aks}} and run south to the [[Agility shortcut]], requiring 10 [[Agility]].
